title: Teaching the Harness: Student-Aware Skill Transfer for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.13144v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective teaching requires reasoning about the learner as well as the task, a capacity that Theory of Mind describes as inferring another agent's latent state from its behavior. We ask whether a stronger LLM teaches a fixed student better when it applies this principle. The student is an LLM agent acting through a harness that fixes its tools, context, and action budget, so a procedure that helps one model can exhaust the budget of another. We introduce Student-Aware Teaching (SAT). The teacher builds a learner model that pairs an empirical profile with hypotheses about the student's limitations, tests these hypotheses with diagnostic probes, and writes reusable skills for the diagnosed failures. A skill enters the library only after it raises success on matched development tasks. translated_title: 教导执行框架：面向大语言模型智能体的学生感知技能迁移
translated_abstract: 有效的教学不仅需要对任务进行推理，还需要对学习者进行推理，这种能力被心智理论描述为从行为推断另一个智能体的潜在状态。我们探究当更强的大语言模型应用这一原则时，能否更好地教导一个固定的学生模型。学生是通过执行框架行动的大语言模型智能体，该框架固定了其工具、上下文和行动预算，因此对一个模型有效的程序可能会耗尽另一个模型的预算。我们提出了学生感知教学方法。教师构建学习者模型，将经验画像与学生局限性的假设相结合，通过诊断性探针测试这些假设，并针对诊断出的失败编写可复用的技能。只有当技能在匹配的开发任务上提升成功率后，才会被纳入技能库。在 Claude-Sonnet-5 教导 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的实验中，SAT 在四次主要运行中达到 86.46% 的任务成功率，优于使用相同方法的无数画像教师……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出学生感知教学方法，教师通过构建学习者画像、假设诊断与探针测试来理解学生模型在固定执行框架下的局限性，并据此编写经验证的可复用技能，使任务成功率达 86.46%。
en_tdlr: Proposes Student-Aware Teaching (SAT), where a stronger LLM teacher builds a learner profile, tests limitation hypotheses with diagnostic probes, and writes validated reusable skills tailored to the student agent's fixed harness, achieving 86.46% task success.
